entries.title: Competing Interpretations
entries.description: More than one valid reading exists and the reviewer must compare them.

entries.title: Evidence Sufficiency
entries.description: The reviewer decides whether the evidence is enough for a conclusion.

entries.title: Confidence Calibration
entries.description: The reviewer adjusts confidence to match evidence quality and uncertainty.

entries.title: Reviewer Disagreement
entries.description: Different reviewers may legitimately disagree and the difference must be recorded.

entries.title: Narrative Justification
entries.description: The story context changes or explains the reviewer outcome.

entries.title: Final Reviewer Decision
entries.description: The combined judgment that resolves evidence, context, disagreement, and confidence.
